details: The broader cryptocurrency market, led by Bitcoin and XRP, experienced a significant rally as Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller indicated he might support holding interest rates steady. This dovish sentiment from the Fed eased macro pressures, leading to a rotation of investors back into riskier assets like cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin surpassed $81,000, and XRP climbed over 9% in 24 hours. The rally was also fueled by a wave of short liquidations.
title: Bitcoin Reclaims $81K Amid Fed Rate Pause Signals

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has proposed allowing issuers to maintain official share registers on a blockchain or other distributed ledger technology. This marks a significant step toward integrating blockchain into traditional finance and could establish a formal regulatory pathway for tokenized securities, extending the logic from capital formation to ongoing record-keeping.
title: SEC Proposes Blockchain for Official Share Registers

details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, a key piece of crypto market structure legislation, faces significant obstacles. A procedural vote is expected in the Senate on September 15th, but House Republican leaders have canceled several voting days, limiting time for potential House action on any Senate amendments. This uncertainty casts doubt on the bill's passage in 2026.
title: CLARITY Act Faces Delays, Uncertainty for September Vote

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen renewed inflows, with a reported $101 million entering on September 3rd, though recent reports had been conflicting. In contrast, Ethereum ETFs recorded a $48.2 million outflow on the same day. This divergence highlights a potential shift in institutional investor sentiment between the two largest cryptocurrencies.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Inflows, Ethereum ETFs Record Outflows

details: Cryptocurrency platform Coinbase Global has appointed Anthony Armstrong, former CFO of Elon Musk's xAI and X Corp., to its board of directors. Armstrong brings extensive experience from traditional finance and frontier technology companies, a move seen as strengthening Coinbase's institutional expertise and strategic positioning amidst evolving regulations.
title: Coinbase Adds Former X Corp. CFO to Board

details: Japanese company Remixpoint has announced a strategic shift to a Bitcoin-only treasury, selling off its holdings in various altcoins including Ethereum, Solana, XRP, and Dogecoin. The company booked a ¥117.8 million profit from these sales, signaling a strong conviction in Bitcoin as a primary treasury asset.
title: Japanese Firm Remixpoint Dumps Altcoins for Bitcoin

details: Standard Chartered has become the first Global Systemically Important Bank (G-Sib) to launch institutional spot Bitcoin and Ethereum trading services in the United Arab Emirates (UAE). This move signifies a growing acceptance and demand for digital assets from traditional financial institutions in the region.
title: Standard Chartered Offers Institutional Spot Crypto Trading in UAE
